en.headline: M+ at Night returns Friday with RubberBand and live performances
en.dek: The museum’s evening programme on 6 November features Cantopop group RubberBand, indie band Goodnight Lillie and the Recycled Orchestra of Cateura until midnight.
body: M+ is holding its M+ at Night programme on Friday evening, transforming the museum into a multi-sensory venue with live music, performances and workshops from 7pm until midnight.

The event, organised by the West Kowloon Cultural District Authority as part of the museum’s fifth-anniversary autumn season, includes sets by Cantopop group RubberBand, indie band Goodnight Lillie and the Recycled Orchestra of Cateura from Paraguay.
Visitors will also encounter Beat Friday Cantopop mashups, dance performances by The Quickies, a Pixel Monster workshop and Oh My Ink AI tattoos. Tickets are priced at HK$320.
The programme is open to the public with advance ticketing through the organisers’ channels.

zh.headline: M+夜不同周五回歸 RubberBand等樂隊演出
zh.dek: 西九文化區M+周五晚上舉行夜不同活動，至午夜有RubberBand、Goodnight Lillie及Recycled Orchestra of Cateura演出。
body: M+周五晚上舉行「M+夜不同」活動，由晚上7時至午夜將博物館化為多感官場地，安排現場音樂、表演及工作坊。
活動由西九文化區管理局籌辦，屬博物館五週年秋季節目之一，演出包括本地樂隊RubberBand、獨立樂隊Goodnight Lillie，以及來自巴拉圭的Recycled Orchestra of Cateura。
當晚亦有Beat Friday廣東流行曲混音、The Quickies舞蹈表演、Pixel Monster工作坊及Oh My Ink AI紋身體驗。門票為320元。
公眾可透過主辦單位渠道購票入場。
